title: How to Prepare for the Danish Citizenship Test
excerpt: Learn Danish society, culture, history and values, and practise with mock tests.
description: How to prepare for Indfødsretsprøven, the Danish citizenship test: what it covers, how to sign up and a simple plan to pass.
body:
Indfødsretsprøven is the Danish citizenship test. It checks your knowledge of Danish society, culture, history and values, and it's held in Danish.

## What it covers

- Danish society and how democracy works
- Culture and traditions
- History, from the Viking Age to modern Denmark
- Danish values

## How to sign up

The test is held on set dates during the year. You sign up through an approved language centre before the deadline. Check the official site for the next date.

## A simple plan

- Study one topic at a time and practise questions on it
- Read questions in Danish from the start, so the language on the day feels normal
- Take timed mock tests and review every wrong answer

Check the official Danish government site for the current format and pass mark. Try a free mock test below, in English or in Danish.
